/.title: KCreations — Couture Designs in Bhutan
/.description: Discover KCreations, the couture house founded by Thinley Wangmo and Kinley Dema. Explore made-to-measure design and request a fitting in Paro, Bhutan.

/collections/men.title: Men’s made-to-measure collection | KCreations
/collections/men.description: Explore men’s suits, jackets and shirts made to your measurements in Bhutan. Choose a house silhouette or bring your own design and preferred fabric.

/collections/women.title: Women’s made-to-measure collection | KCreations
/collections/women.description: Explore women’s tailored jackets, dresses and traditional garments from KCreations. Create your own fit with a house design or a reference of your own.

/artists.title: Thinley Wangmo & Kinley Dema | KCreations artists
/artists.description: Meet KCreations founders Thinley Wangmo and Kinley Dema, 2 sisters carrying their father Kado’s tailoring legacy into contemporary Bhutanese fashion.

/artists/profile.title: The K Creations couture house & heritage
/artists/profile.description: Discover the K Creations story, from Kado’s dressmaking legacy in 1980s Paro to the contemporary couture house led by Kinley Dema and Thinley Wangmo.

/careers.title: Careers at KCreations | Paro, Bhutan
/careers.description: Explore career opportunities with KCreations, a family-led couture studio based in Paro, Bhutan.
